# Nested Structure

## Deep Nested Lists

- A
  - A-1
    - A-1-a
      - A-1-a-i
    - A-1-b
  - A-2
- B
  - B-1

## Mixed List Types

1. Ordered top
   - Unordered child
     1. Ordered grandchild
   - Another unordered
2. Ordered second

## Nested Quotes

> Level 1
>
> > Level 2
> >
> > > Level 3 with **bold**

## Task List Nesting

- [ ] Parent task
  - [x] Sub task done
  - [ ] Sub task pending
    - [x] Sub-sub done
